title: Bots belong to the organization, not to a person
description:

comments.text: summary: Implemented in PR #173 (squash-merged to develop as 55c93b8) as part of Phase 5 org-scoping. Bots drop user_id (name uniqueness (tenant,name)); channels drop user_id (roster keyed per human participant); computer drops user_id (computer_for_user -> computer_for_organization, POST /computers/stopped body {stopped} only). All 3 shared_channels.feature scenarios from 14f692 now pass. Worker protocol changed — workers redeploy with the org computer_id. Docs (PRODUCT.md, THREAT_MODEL.md, AGENTS.md) aligned to organization-scoped computer. Gates: black, ruff, pytest (470), behave (shared_channels 3/3); PR #173 CI green. Closing.
